indications: Digoxin is a cardiac glycoside indicated for: Treatment of mild to moderate heart failure in adults. ( 1.1 ) Control of resting ventricular rate in adults with chronic atrial fibrillation. ( 1.3 )
contraindications: Digoxin dose is based on patient-specific factors (age, lean body weight, renal function, etc.). See full prescribing information. Monitor for toxicity and therapeutic effect. ( 2 ) Intravenous administration is preferable to intramuscular. Avoid bolus administration. ( 2 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
Digoxin Injection, USP is available as:
                  500 mcg/2 mL (250 mcg/mL) single-dose ampuls packaged in 25s (NDC 0641-1410-35)
                  
                     Store at 20˚ to 25˚C (68˚ to 77˚F), excursions permitted to 15˚ to 30˚C (59˚ to 86˚F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Protect from light. Discard unused portion.
adverseReactions:
Digoxin is contraindicated in patients with:
                  
                     Ventricular fibrillation [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)]
                     
                     Known hypersensitivity to digoxin (reactions seen include unexplained rash, swelling of the mouth, lips or throat or a difficulty in breathing). A hypersensitivity reaction to other digitalis preparations usually constitutes a contraindication to digoxin.
name: Digoxin
